note: Ids are positions in Net.packetClasses: 7 framework packets, then Call.registerPackets() (sorted @Remote methods). fields: what write() puts in the body, in order ('if' marks the net.server()/net.client() checks of Loc.both packets). read: what handled() reads, in order. calls: the Call methods that send the packet: 'variant' all (net.send), one (to a NetConnection), forward (server relays a client's call to the others); 'reliable' false means UDP; 'sentBy' is the side check before sending; 'local' is the method also run locally by the sender.
